description: Search IconSaga icons by meaning, in the user's own language (English, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Indonesian or mixed). Best: one search per icon, the thing it shows in 1-3 words ("refund", "ลูกศรซ้าย", "地図のピン"). A whole request also works: words that only ask ("find me an icon for", "please", ช่วยหา…หน่อย) are left out. Also takes an icon name as UI icon sets write it (arrow-right, circle-check, shopping-cart, trash-2, HomeIcon) and returns the matching icon first. Several things in one query ("calendar clock schedule"): when no icon has every word, the icons that have the most of the words come first (relaxed "any-words"; each result lists the words it matched in "matched", and "unmatched" the words no icon has). Returns icon ids, labels, versions, styles and licence per icon.

lang.description: Language of the labels in the answer, and of the names ranked first: en, th, es, pt-BR, fr, de, ja, zh-Hans, ko or id (regions and names such as pt, zh-CN, ja-JP or "Japanese" also work). Default: the language of the query. Give it when you know the user's language

query.description: What the icon should show, e.g. "invoice", "ลูกศรซ้าย", "carrito de compras", "地図のピン", "home บ้าน"

set.description: Only icons of this set (see list_sets)

style.description: Only icons available in this style

name: search_icons
title: Search icons
